summary: Keep one implementation owner because shared contracts, tenant role semantics, privacy rules, migrations, Console routes, and cross-repository API parity overlap. Execute ordered slices for contracts and schemas, OSS API/Console/CLI, Enterprise API/RLS/SCIM/Helm, then tests, documentation, and review.
decision_refs: single writer for all repository changes
Enterprise consumes the versioned OSS Console and contract packages rather than copied source
validation may run independently only after implementation converges
residual_risks: The single implementation task is large but avoids cross-repository contract drift and conflicting schema edits.
